evidence.quote: Dr. Dickenson’s research, advocacy, teaching, and clinical work focus on increasing sexual literacy across people of all sexual orientations and genders , with the aim to augment sexual wellbeing across the population .
Assistant Teaching Professor of Psychology at University of California, San Diego
Sexual Wellbeing and Gender ( SWAG ) Lab Meet Our Team Janna Dickenson, PhD, LP Principal Investigator

By using research to discover truths about sexuality, Dr. Dickenson has challenged the veracity of intuitive claims about sexuality (e.g., Sex during youth can be good! Sexual orientation exists! Sexual orientation can change, but you cannot control that change!) and has demonstrated just how important present-moment attention actually is for sexual response and pleasure.
